ModMetaData.name: The Dead Man's Switch - Unwoven
ModMetaData.author: Moebius
ModMetaData.description:
This is mod is in pre-beta, a series of personal experiments that may or may not evolve to a proper something. Subscribe at your own risk!
Rebalance for Dead Man's Switch and some of its submods.
- Removes quality variance from weapons and armor (but not some apparels) - Add Refurbishment recipe for repairing the weapons and armor above mentioned - Add waste generation to all automated buildings - Add Nuclear Battery to some traders (instead of rare loot only)
Roadmap - Improve recipes and research - Hide redundant items - New Ideology - Several improvements to Dragoons and Ancients - A LOT more
ALl silly lil xml patches coded by me DMS is an amazing series of mods, all credits to Aoba and team.
